# PC Build Check

PC Build Check provides preliminary PC component balance estimates, FPS estimates,
power-supply guidance, and educational resources. Results are planning aids rather
than measured benchmarks or compatibility guarantees.

## Main tools

- [PC Bottleneck Calculator](https://www.pcbuildcheck.com/en)
- [FPS Calculator](https://www.pcbuildcheck.com/en/fps-calculator)
- [PSU Calculator](https://www.pcbuildcheck.com/en/psu-calculator)
- [PC Tools](https://www.pcbuildcheck.com/en/tools)

## Reference content

- [Methodology](https://www.pcbuildcheck.com/en/methodology)
- [PC Hardware Guides](https://www.pcbuildcheck.com/en/blog)
- [About PC Build Check](https://www.pcbuildcheck.com/en/about)
